description: Building Inventory Generation v1.0.0 is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Meredith Lochhead (Stanford University). This is the initial public release of the Building_Inventory_Generation repository, accompanying the manuscript "Exposure Matters: A Synthesis Framework for High-Resolution Building Inventory Development" (Lochhead, Zsarnóczay, Deierlein), available at https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijdrr.2026.106148. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
